name: AttaPoll
selection: AttaPoll shows the estimated minutes and reward for each survey card. NEVER tap a card whose text layer contains 'Unlock surveys' — those are locked and cannot be started. NEVER tap a card that shows lock/upgrade prompts or profiling text (for example 'Unlock'). Only tap unlocked cards. Rank unlocked cards by the minutes shown on the card itself (lowest wins); if minutes are not shown, prefer higher $ reward. Never start a survey estimated over 5 minutes. If every unlocked card is over 5 minutes, wait for new surveys instead of tapping a locked or over-limit card. Never guess speed from question count or stars — only use explicit minutes/$ shown on the card. Avoid surveys whose title suggests a long diary or a follow-up study.
qualification: Prefer neutral, low-consumption answers that qualify without contradicting earlier answers. Examples: 'None of the above', 'No', 'Never', 'I do not drink alcohol', 'I do not smoke'. Keep answers internally consistent for the whole session.
navigation: AttaPoll starts surveys inside its own WebView. Once you have tapped a survey and the screen shows questions, you are already inside the survey: never go back to the list until the survey finishes or fails. Answer every question, then tap the on-screen Next/Submit control instead of swiping.
exit: When AttaPoll reports a screen-out, quota full, or 'Sorry that didn't work out', dismiss the dialog with its close/back control and return to the survey list. Do not start the same survey again.
warnings: Do not reload or restart the app while a survey is in progress.
If a reward confirmation appears, acknowledge it and return to the list.
